meaning: Suppose a world w accesses no world. By Ax2a the empty property or its negation is positive at w; not the empty property (step 1). At w every necessity holds vacuously, so the negation of the empty property is necessarily included in the empty property, and by Ax4 the empty property is positive at w: contradiction. Not a step of the AFP proof; it replaces the frame reasoning hidden in its smt step 5.
